usageNotes: Use this to modify an existing cluster-wide logical PCI mapping — updating which physical PCI devices on each node back the mapping, toggling mdev/live-migration-capable flags, or refreshing the description. Requires the Mapping.Modify privilege on /mapping/pci/{id}. Pass the digest returned from the corresponding GET to prevent overwriting concurrent changes.

examples.summary: Add a node entry and enable mdev on an existing GPU mapping

params.description: NVIDIA RTX A2000 - mediated device pool

tips: Fetch the current mapping first (get_cluster_mapping_pci_id) to obtain the digest before writing.
Use the 'delete' param to remove individual keys (e.g., 'description') without touching the rest of the mapping.
live-migration-capable is experimental; enabling it without compatible hardware/drivers will cause migration failures.
The mapping must already exist — use post_cluster_mapping_pci to create a new one.
